description: Config-driven CRUD scaffolding for Laravel + Inertia.js (React/TypeScript) with normalized Index/Form/Show pages, native chunked uploads, sync & queued background CSV imports, SoftDeletes, declarative custom actions, and role-based permissions.
rules: Always use v2 normalized pages: <ResourceIndex {...props} />, <ResourceForm {...props} />, and <ResourceShow {...props} /> with AppLayout breadcrumbs bound to page.props?.meta?.breadcrumbs ?? [].
Control Export and Import visibility via 'export' and 'import' inside resourceConfig()['actions'], not via hardcoded exportRoute/importRoute props.
Use int|string $id when overriding show(), edit(), update(), destroy(), restore(), or forceDestroy() on CrudController subclasses.
Use the native chunked-file field type (endpoint /crud/chunk-upload is auto-registered) instead of defining manual chunk upload routes.
For large CSV imports, configure resourceConfig()['import'] with mode 'auto' or 'queued' and optional chunked_upload => true.
